title: Use Biblicus's GROBID launcher instead of a Papyrus copy
description: references_commands.py carries its own GROBID Docker launcher (lfoppiano/grobid:0.8.0, same container name biblicus-grobid, no restart policy, no memory limit, published on all interfaces). It can recreate the amd64 image that is OOM-killed under emulation on Apple Silicon. Replace it with biblicus.grobid_runtime.ensure_grobid_running and resolve_grobid_base_url, the official launcher in Biblicus 1.15.0. Follows PPY-e6f517 and Biblicus blbs-f41c9d / blbs-d59cb4.
